title: OIDC
description: Configuration holds the configuration for the OIDC middleware.

claims.description: Claims defines an expression to perform validation on the ID token. For example: Equals(`grp`, `admin`) && Equals(`scope`, `deploy`)

csrf.description: CSRF defines whether the CSRF protection is enabled.

disableAuthRedirectionPaths.description: DisableAuthRedirectionPaths disables the automatic redirection to the identity provider when no valid session is found for requests matching this set of path prefixes. It makes the middleware respond with a 401 instead of trying to initialize a new authorization code flow.

disableIssuerCheck.description: DisableIssuerCheck determines whether the issuer value check between the middleware configuration, the discovery endpoint, and the token's issuer is bypassed.

discoveryParams.description: Map of arbitrary query parameters to be added to the openid-configuration well-known URI during the discovery mechanism.

forwardHeaders.description: ForwardHeaders defines headers that should be added to the request and populated with values extracted from the ID token.

pkce.description: PKCE determines whether Proof Key for Code Exchange is enabled for the authorization code flow. When enabled, uses S256 challenge method.

trustedIssuer.description: TrustedIssuer allows discovery to work when the issuer_url reported by upstream is mismatched with the discovery URL.

usernameClaim.description: UsernameClaim defines the claim used to set the clientUsername in the accessLog.
